title: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25320v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. translated_title: 通过残差学习分配改进多阶段任务的模仿策略
translated_abstract: 残差强化学习通过有限的环境交互预算来纠正基于模仿学习训练的基础策略。在包含多个阶段的任务中，该预算必须分配到各个阶段之中，而基础策略失败所在的阶段并不一定是对其进行纠正最能提升任务完成度的阶段。我们通过“完成增益”这一概念将该区别形式化：即在某一个阶段内，当状态反馈控制器替代基础策略动作中的选定组件时，整个任务完成概率的变化。我们将完成增益分解为到达该阶段的概率以及从该阶段开始时的条件完成改进，并通过配对的回合数据进行估计。正的估计值决定了残差策略应纠正哪些动作组件，以及训练回合应如何在不同阶段之间分配。在随机点质量对接实验中，大多数失败发生在……
tldr: 该论文提出“完成增益”概念，将其分解为阶段到达概率与条件完成改进，据此指导残差强化学习在多阶段任务中纠正哪些动作组件以及如何在各阶段间分配有限的训练预算。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the "completion gain," decomposed into phase-arrival probability and conditional completion improvement, to determine which action components residual policies should correct and how to allocate the limited training budget across phases in multi-phase tasks.
